name: jobdraft
description: JobDraft: tailored job application drafts in each user's own Gmail, twice a day.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run start --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test --prefix server
